What this page measures

  1. 01
    Physical footprint

    File bytes are sampled after the node is fully synced. WAL bytes belong beside, not inside, the main-file measurement.

  2. 02
    Daily state transitions

    RPC additions and removals are counted per block, then grouped by the block's UTC date.

  3. 03
    Binary at delivery time

    Git keeps append-only source data. The compact CDB1 payload is generated only for the static deployment.
